My sister was in an accident late last night/early this morning. She posted that she and her 4 kids weren't hurt, but I haven't been able to reach her yet. 

As of now, I'm taking Tuesday planning to help her get her burnt car towed back to Grand junction, get her and the kids a rental car, and anything else I might be able to help her with. 

I've been trying to stay consistent with being open, and I really am sorry to close. 

Yesterday you all really showed up for me and I'm so grateful! As much as I need to open, I have to be there for my family right now. Thank you all for you thoughts and prayers! 🙏
